Definition: from G2919; a judge (genitive case or specially):--judge.
BiblicalUsage: Krites is the judge, and the New Testament gives the title to Christ above all. Paul calls Him "the righteous judge" in 2 Timothy 4:8, Peter preaches in Acts 10:42 that He is ordained of God "to be the Judge of quick and dead," and Hebrews 12:23 speaks of "God the Judge of all."
TheologicalSignificance: To my mind, there is comfort in the title: the Judge is righteous, He is the one who died for the judged, and that is the only reason I can look forward to His judgment instead of dreading it. He is the righteous Judge, and He is also my advocate.
